Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, a As Object, b As Object, c As Object, d As Object
    Dim sr As Object, kept As Object, s As String, v As String, s0 As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set a = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Set b = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 60, 100, 40)
    Set c = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 10, 110, 100, 40)
    Set d = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 160, 110, 200)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
    Case 1
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, c.Name))
    Case 2
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, d.Name))
    Case 3
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name))
    Case 4
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 5
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: b.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 6
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Fill.Transparency = 0.5
    Case 7
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 8
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 9
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Line.Weight = 3
    Case 10
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Line.DashStyle = msoLineDash
    Case 11
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 12
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Line.Transparency = 0.5
    Case 13
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 14
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Fill.Transparency = 0.5
    Case 15
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 16
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Fill.Solid
    Case 17
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 18
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Line.Weight = 3
    Case 19
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Line.DashStyle = msoLineDash

        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 21
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Line.Transparency = 0.5
    Case 22
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, c.Name))
        sr.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 23
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, c.Name))
        sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 24

        sr.Line.Weight = 3
    Case 25

        sr.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255

        sr.Fill.Visible = msoTrue

        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, d.Name))
        sr.Line.Weight = 3
    Case 30
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, d.Name))
        sr.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 31
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name))
        sr.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 32
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        Set kept = sr.Fill: a.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: s0 = kept.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 33
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        Set kept = sr.Fill: a.Delete: s0 = kept.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 34
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Line.Weight = -1
    Case 35
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Fill.Transparency = 2
    Case 36
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse: sr.Fill.Visible = msoTrue

        a.Fill.Visible = msoFalse: b.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 43

        a.Fill.Visible = msoFalse: sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 44
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        b.Fill.Visible = msoFalse: sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 45
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 46
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        b.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 47
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 48
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse: sr.Fill.Visible = msoTrue
    Case 49
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Fill.Transparency = 0.5: sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 50
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Line.Weight = 3: sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 51
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(d.Name, a.Name))
        sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 52
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name, c.Name))
        sr.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 53
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Line.Visible = msoFalse: sr.Line.Visible = msoTrue
    Case 54
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Line.Visible = msoFalse: b.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 55
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        a.Line.Visible = msoFalse: sr.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 56
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Line.Visible = msoFalse: sr.Line.Weight = 3
    Case 57
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Line.Visible = msoFalse: sr.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 58
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
        sr.Fill.BackColor.RGB = 255
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sr.Fill.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sr.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear

    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 58
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
